theme.title: The Numbers Game
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: Down 2–0 in the 2006 Finals, how many points did Dwyane Wade score to win Game 3?
questions.note: 42 with 13 rebounds, rallying Miami from 13 down.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Led by Dwyane Wade's 42 points and 13 rebounds, the Heat rallied from a 13-point deficit

funFacts.text: Gary Payton capped Miami's late comeback with a jumper in the closing seconds.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The momentum-changing comeback was capped by a Gary Payton field goal from just inside the three-point line with 9.3 seconds left.

funFacts.text: Wade also grabbed 13 rebounds in the crucial home victory.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Led by Dwyane Wade's 42 points and 13 rebounds

funFacts.text: Dirk Nowitzki missed a late free throw that could have tied the game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Dirk Nowitzki had a chance to tie the game at the free throw line with 3.4 seconds to go, but missed 1 of 2

questions.prompt: Shane Battier hit 6 threes in Game 7 of the 2013 Finals. How many did Ray Allen make in Game 2 of the 2010 Finals?
questions.context: 2010 NBA Finals · Game 2 · at Los Angeles
questions.note: Eight, on 11 attempts, a Finals record at the time.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Allen hit eight of 11 three-pointers, breaking a Finals record

funFacts.text: Ray Allen's barrage featured a second-quarter shooting display in which he barely missed from deep.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In the 2nd quarter, Ray Allen hit an impressive five three-pointers (only missing once)

funFacts.text: Rajon Rondo also delivered a triple-double in Boston's road win at Staples Center.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Rondo finished with an impressive triple-double of 19 points, 12 rebounds and 10 assists

funFacts.text: The series was tied after Boston's win, the first Finals to reach that position since Lakers–Pistons in 2004.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The last Finals series to be tied at 1–1 after two games was the 2004 NBA Finals

questions.prompt: The chart shows three other supporting-cast Finals scoring games. How many points did Aaron Gordon score in Game 4 of the 2023 Finals?
questions.context: Denver Nuggets at Miami Heat · June 9, 2023
questions.note: 27 points, his highest-scoring game of that Finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Aaron Gordon's 27 points helped the Nuggets prevent a comeback attempt

funFacts.text: Gordon made 11 of his 15 field-goal attempts in the Game 4 victory.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Gordon dropped a game-high 27 points on 11 of 15 from the field

funFacts.text: The Game 4 win was Denver's fifth straight road victory of that postseason.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Nuggets won their fifth straight road game

funFacts.text: Bruce Brown supplied 11 fourth-quarter points off Denver's bench to help end a Miami comeback.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bruce Brown came off the bench and scored 11 of his 21 points in the fourth quarter

questions.prompt: In Kobe and Shaq's iconic 2000 West finals Game 7 comeback against Portland, how many points down were the Lakers?
questions.context: Lakers vs Trail Blazers · 2000 West finals
questions.note: 16 points down. Kobe's alley-oop to Shaq sealed the comeback that launched the dynasty.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In Game 7, the Lakers overcame a 16-point deficit (71–55) and sealed the victory with Kobe Bryant delivering an alley-oop to Shaquille O'Neal.

funFacts.text: Kobe's alley-oop to Shaq helped seal the comeback.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kobe Bryant delivering an alley-oop to Shaquille O'Neal

funFacts.text: Los Angeles survived a low-scoring deciding game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Portland Trail Blazers 84, Los Angeles Lakers 89
